Tempo.question: The _____ was Musical concept indicating to the speed of interpretation.
Tempo.fact: In musical terminology, tempo (from Italian for 'time'; plural 'tempos', or tempi from the Italian plural), measured in beats per minute, is the speed or pace of a given composition, and is often also an indication of the composition's character or atmosphere. In classical music, tempo is typically indicated with an instruction at the start of a piece (often using conventional Italian terms) and, if a specific metrical pace is desired, is usually measured in beats per minute (bpm or BPM).

Italian is typically used because it was the language of most composers during the time these descriptions became commonplace in the Western musical lexicon.
